changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla diagnostics: diagnóstico de la inscripción con guardado parcial y nivel por tema. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría diagnostics_audit y el trigger diagnostics_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Diagnostic test of an enrollment (one per enrollment), with partial saving

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment that takes the diagnostic

column.name: status
column.remarks: Diagnostic status: created, in_progress, submitted, scoring, scored or scoring_failed

column.name: item_ids
column.remarks: Ids of the assessment items shown, as a JSON array

column.name: answers
column.remarks: Learner answers (partial saving)

column.name: level_by_topic
column.remarks: Level per topic with test_score, resume_prior, profile_prior, weights, level and classification

column.name: submitted_at
column.remarks: Moment the learner submitted the diagnostic

column.name: scored_at
column.remarks: Moment the diagnostic was scored

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE diagnostics ADD CONSTRAINT diagnostics_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('created', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'scoring', 'scored', 'scoring_failed'))
ALTER TABLE diagnostics ADD CONSTRAINT diagnostics_item_ids_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(item_ids) = 'array')
CREATE TRIGGER diagnostics_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON diagnostics FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in diagnostics

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE diagnostics_audit ADD CONSTRAINT diagnostics_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER diagnostics_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostics FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS diagnostics_audit_trg ON diagnostics
